In this article

  • Latest
  • 2026-08-01
  • 2024-02-01-preview

Bicep resource definition

The serviceGroups resource type can be deployed with operations that target:

  • Tenant - See tenant deployment commands

For a list of changed properties in each API version, see change log.

Usage Examples

Azure Verified Modules

The following Azure Verified Modules can be used to deploy this resource type.

Module Description
Service Group AVM Resource Module for Service Group

Resource format

To create a Microsoft.Management/serviceGroups resource, add the following Bicep to your template.

resource symbolicname 'Microsoft.Management/serviceGroups@2026-08-01' = {
  kind: 'string'
  name: 'string'
  properties: {
    attributes: {
      criticality: int
    }
    displayName: 'string'
    parent: {
      resourceId: 'string'
    }
  }
  tags: {
    {customized property}: 'string'
  }
}

Property Values

Microsoft.Management/serviceGroups

Name Description Value
kind The kind of the serviceGroup. string
name The resource name string

Constraints:
Pattern = ^[a-zA-Z0-9\-_().]{1,90}$ (required)
properties ServiceGroup creation request body parameters. ServiceGroupProperties
tags Resource tags Dictionary of tag names and values. See Tags in templates

ParentServiceGroupProperties

Name Description Value
resourceId The fully qualified ID of the parent serviceGroup. For example, '/providers/Microsoft.Management/serviceGroups/TestServiceGroup' string

ServiceGroupAttributes

Name Description Value
criticality The criticality designation of the service group. Valid values range from 0 through 4. int

Constraints:
Min value = 0
Max value = 4

ServiceGroupProperties

Name Description Value
attributes The attributes of the serviceGroup. ServiceGroupAttributes
displayName The display name of the serviceGroup. For example, ServiceGroupTest1 string
parent The details of the parent serviceGroup. ParentServiceGroupProperties

ServiceGroupTags

Name Description Value
